meta.protocol: features for each fight use only earlier fights (walk-forward); time-ordered CV on 2010-2023 (expanding window, validation blocks 2016-17, 2018-19, 2020-21, 2022-23) for every choice; out-of-fold 2019-2023 predictions from annual expanding refits feed recalibration and stacking; 2024+ scored once by models trained on 2010-2023 (refit variants marked *_refit retrain each January with frozen hyperparameters). Draws and no-contests are excluded from winner metrics; DQ and NC are excluded from 7-bin metrics. Every model is corner-symmetric.

eval_sets.oof: backtest.json fights 2019-2023 (both men had a prior UFC fight)

keys.fights: per backtest fight id: set (oof|test), y (1 = A won, 0 = B won, null = draw/NC), bin7 (0..6), elo, elo_sig (strike-share Elo), lr, gbm (LightGBM), xgb, ml (blend), ml_iso (isotonic-recalibrated blend), stack (recommended pre-line stack), *_refit (annual-refit variants, test only), bins7 (recommended 7-bin model: A KO, A SUB, A DEC, draw, B DEC, B SUB, B KO); all probabilities are P(A wins | decisive) with A = first ufcstats name
keys.gbm_test: LightGBM P(A wins) for every 2024+ backtest fight (trained on 2010-2023)
keys.page_model: logistic winner model + method-given-winner softmax that the page can evaluate in JS for any two roster fighters (see research/model_ml.md)
keys.roster: per-fighter feature values as of the snapshot, keyed by fighters.json slug

sources.market: data/derived/market.json (tools/market.py): p_power_close = power de-vig of the consensus close; p_novig_open = multiplicative de-vig of the opening line; p_market_rating = walk-forward Kalman market rating from earlier closing lines (usable before a line exists)
sources.engine: data/derived/moe_engine_bt.json (engine v3.0.0 via tools/moe_engine_bt.js, 100 sims per corner order, pA/(pA+pB))

winner.fit: L2 logistic, no intercept, every decisive UFC fight 2010-01-01..2026-10-31 (7568 fights), lam=0.1, train_set=all; held-out numbers are for the same specification fit on 2010-2023 only
winner.eval: p(A wins) = 1 / (1 + exp(-platt_slope * sum_j coef_j * term_j(A, B))); exactly antisymmetric, so p(B beats A) = 1 - p(A beats B)

method.eval: x = [side_block(winner), side_block(loser), context]; softmax(intercept + coef @ x) = P(KO/TKO, SUB, DEC | that fighter wins)

page_model.dynamic_keys: age, layoff, log_layoff, years_ufc, wc_move, new_class are recomputed for the fight date and weight from _dob, _last_fight, the snapshot date, _prev_lbs and _lbs_fought (see page_sides() in tools/ml.py); everything else is as of the snapshot
